full_cap_note: 4.5G hard cap per payload; full + metadata + signatures <= 5G wire
delta_note: 1.2G soft warn + notes line, 2.0G hard drop to full-only
fleet_cap_note: 8GB rule: full + sum(served incrementals) + 1 retry each <= 8G per from-version
delta_ship_note: ship incremental only if <= 60 pct of full AND <= hard cap, else delta-skipped:<reason>
chunk_note: 100M per-file bsdiff hunk cap; larger hunks fall back to full-file deflate, logged per-file
compressor_note: pinned per release in MANIFEST.lock, never floated
block_note: must match erofs -C4096; CI asserts the match
